$Comment: Retired: this quest is never handed to anyone. The Mastery Trainer's lessons pay mastery points in
its place: the daily board Mmo_Mastery_Lessons raises standing with the trainer (the reputation
Mmo_Mastery_Trainer), each rank pays its points through an achievement in the book, and the
Master's lessons pay a point a day at the top. A fixed tithe coming round every six hours would
undercut that ladder, which is why it stays off.
AutoAccept false is what stops it arming for anyone, and Listing.Hidden keeps it off open lists.
Repeat.MaxCompletions 1 makes it done for good once a player has collected it, so somebody who paid
it before never finds it offered again in their Objective Book, where a quest they once started
would otherwise come back each time its six hours ran out.
The steps and the reward are left whole, so a player who is carrying it can still finish it and
collect its point, and its completion record keeps answering: What You Already Paid
(Mastery_Tithe_Credit.json) reads that record through ziggfreedcommon:quest_completions to give
everyone who ever paid it a head start with the trainer. The Requires block (500 total levels and
the 300-point hoarder achievement) gates nothing, since the quest never arms.
Keep the file and its id: a player's progress on it is filed under pack_mastery_tithe.
Name: Pack_Mastery_Tithe
